title: LagGuiPlugins
description: Lightweight and admin-focused diagnostic plugin that helps you analyze your installed plugins
body:
LagGuiPlugins is a lightweight, admin-focused diagnostic plugin that lets you analyze all installed plugins directly in an in-game GUI.

View detailed information such as scheduled task count, registered commands, dependencies, services, plugin size, and data folder usage. Generate snapshot reports to better understand which plugins may contribute to server lag.

Perfect for server owners who want insight instead of guesswork.
Works on Spigot 1.18+ • No NMS • Free to use
